I work on practical software systems, machine learning, and technical writing. This site collects a short bio, project notes, and longer articles about engineering ideas worth returning to.

My current interests include machine learning systems, developer tools, autonomous systems, applied research, media tooling, and concise technical communication.

## Research and Technical Interests

- Machine learning systems that make model behavior observable, testable, and useful in production.
- Tools for turning messy real-world media, text, and data into reliable workflows.
- Interfaces for technical users where the product surface stays quiet and the capability is deep.
- Writing that connects implementation details to the larger engineering decisions behind them.
